context: Request: the first traditional, non-SPAC IPO the firm took public, with its offering documents and something showing the deal closed. Rubric: 1037-00001 (Solstice Biomedical Devices), an offering document (underwriting, registration-rights or lock-up agreement), a closing deliverable (closing checklist or officer's/secretary's certificate), plus a precision criterion.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob.

stages.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Reads engagement letters, agreements, closing documents and emails of the three matters at the top of the listing.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Content-mode grep for request keywords (its output is mostly compressed document bytes) plus a files-with-matches grep for listing and closing words.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists all files of three candidate matters.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Two batches reading memos, draft filings, a timeline, emails and closing memos of those matters.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes that no completed offering of the requested kind is evidenced and discusses the closest candidates.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Read documents picked from the file listing → Search file contents for request keywords → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: The matter never surfaced; the content grep printed compressed bytes and the agent screened only candidates from a broad grep, then answered that none qualifies.

first_error.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
first_error.why: Its content grep printed compressed document bytes rather than text and its second grep was too broad to point anywhere; the matter it needed never surfaced, and it did not search file names or scan document text.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus a shell find to depth two (empty).

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: find | grep over file paths for request keywords, first 240 hits only.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script for request keywords; times out after about 839K chars.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists files of two matters.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: find | grep for filing-document words, excluding two matters already seen.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists all files of three candidate matters from that list.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Two batches reading filings, an agreement, closing documents and memos, mostly of one candidate.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Three searches for an earlier completed offering: a grep -R (empty), a date-phrase script, and a phrase scan that times out with a memo of another matter at the very end of its output.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes the screened candidate as the first completed offering.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file names for request keywords → Scan document text with an extraction script → List files in candidate matters → Search file names for request keywords → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Scan document text with an extraction script → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: File-name searches capped at 240 hits and a timed-out scan never reached the matter; it appeared only at the tail of a last timed-out scan, which the agent did not follow up before naming another matter.

first_error.stage: Search file names for request keywords
first_error.why: Its first file-name search printed only the first 240 hits, which did not reach the matter, and the scan after it timed out; the narrower name search it then relied on matched no file of that matter.

other_errors.why: The last scan's partial output ended with a memo from the matter it needed, but it wrote the answer without opening it.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob.

stages.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Reads memos, agreements, closing checklists and emails of the three matters at the top of the listing.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Content-mode grep for request keywords; its output is mostly compressed document bytes.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Lists two candidate matters' files and reads a closing memo and two emails from three candidates (labelled by the dominant intent).

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads the filings, agreement, emails, checklist and closing receipt of the matter it picked.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Lists one more candidate's files and reads two of its documents plus two more of the picked matter (labelled by the dominant intent).

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes the picked matter as the first completed offering.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Read documents picked from the file listing → Search file contents for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Its only search was a content grep that printed compressed bytes; the matter never surfaced and the agent named a later offering from another matter.

first_error.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
first_error.why: Its only search was a content grep whose output was compressed document bytes; the matter it needed never surfaced and it did not search file names or scan document text.

divergence: All three failed the same way: the qualifying matter never surfaced (search miss). T0 and T2 relied on content greps that printed compressed document bytes, then screened candidates suggested by the listing and a broad grep; T1 ran file-name searches capped at 240 hits and a timed-out scan, and saw the matter only at the end of a last timed-out scan it did not follow up. T0 answered that none qualifies; T1 and T2 named a later offering from another matter.
